zh: 埃默里大学（Emory University）成立于1836年，简称"埃默里"或"Emory"，是一所全美顶尖的私立研究型大学，美国25所"新常春藤"院校之一，素有"南部哈佛"的美誉，也是美国小班制精英教育的代表院校。学校在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第182位，2026U.S.News全美大学排名第24位。学校拥有世界级的教学团队和教授资源，百分之九十九的教职员工拥有该领域的最高学历（博士或以上）。
en: Emory University, founded in 1836, is a top private research university in the United States, one of the 25 "New Ivy" institutions, known as the "Harvard of the South", and a representative of small-class elite education in the US. Ranked 182nd in the QS World University Rankings 2026 and 24th in the 2026 U.S.News National University Rankings, Emory has a world-class teaching team with 99% of faculty holding the highest degree in their field (PhD or above).
